Returning to this chat skips reprocessing the conversation. Uses disk space: models with large contexts can take hundreds of MB per chat.
This frees the disk space used by every saved chat cache. Per-chat switches stay on and the caches are rebuilt on the next reply in each chat.
Disk cache only works with local llama.cpp servers started by this app, not remote servers, Ollama, llama-swap or LiteRT.

Keep the KV cache on disk?

This chat\'s KV cache will be saved on disk so returning to it does not reprocess the prompt. To apply it, this chat\'s local llama.cpp server will be restarted and the model will reload. Cache files can use hundreds of MB.
This chat\'s KV cache will be saved on disk so returning to it does not reprocess the prompt. The server is not running, so nothing needs restarting now. Cache files can use hundreds of MB.

Chats, DeepSeek subagents and harness agents will reprocess their prompts next time. Conversations are not affected.

A base cache holds the preprocessed system prompt (tool instructions) and tool definitions, so new chats only process their own first message. A chat\'s own cache never overwrites it; it is rebuilt only when missing or when the model, context, tools or template change.
Built from this server\'s default tools. Chats with the same tools restore it; the chat\'s own system prompt and knowledge-base notes are placed after it.

System prompt and tools of the DeepSeek Harness agent (about 10k tokens), with the port and project folder lines moved out so it stays identical. Rebuilt from the last prompt a harness task sent to this server.
System prompt and tools of the DeepSeek subagent, shared by every task on this server. Built with this server\'s default thinking setting, the one the subagent uses.
